_readme: Coverage map for arXiv:2607.28411v1 -- 'Stability conditions and moduli spaces on projective families', Li, Liu, Liu, Macri, Perry, Stellari, Zhao. Created for destination issue #211, transferred from source issue #141.

THIS IS NOT A TRUST RECORD AND NOT A MINT SURFACE. It is a zero-claim map of the paper's structure onto statuses. formalization.yaml's `source` remains the Bridgeland 2007 record, and registry/bridgeland2007.json remains the only mint surface; nothing in this file changes either, and nothing in this file may be cited as theorem coverage. The only status that ever counts as coverage is 'formalized'.
Run it before and after every edit. It fails on any status outside the vocabulary, any non-target status without complete evidence, and any corpus-derived identifier key.

Update ownership: the owner (Chris Dare) promotes statuses; agents may propose a promotion only by a landing PR carrying the evidence fields the validator demands, and 'formalized' additionally requires explicit owner acceptance recorded in the entry. Adding sections, fixing titles against the pinned PDF, and adding tracking links are ordinary edits; status promotion is not.
Quotes: none are minted here. When a quote is later needed it must be checked directly against the v1 artifact identified in `source`, never against an unversioned corpus extraction.

near_term_coordinates.note: Theorem 2.8 and Definitions 2.9/2.11: scalar extension and geometric stability. Target only; no coverage claim.
Definitions 3.1/3.6 and Propositions 3.3/3.8, followed by the geometric Bayer/cofiltration criteria. Target only; the separate §3.4 coordinate records the existing candidate mapping.
The elliptic-power family, algebraic `(P¹)^n` seed, transfer to `P^n`, pullback to `X`, and embedding-independent distinguished component. Target only.
Mass-Hom bounds, tilt comparisons, and supported derived categories of vector-bundle total spaces. Target only.

Definitions 8.2 and 8.4--8.6: relative-perfect/universally-gluable objects, M_pug, and boundedness. Substantial repository infrastructure exists, but this coordinate remains target pending source-faithfulness review.
Definition 8.7 and Proposition 8.10: the relative numerical K-group and its pushforward/pullback functoriality. Target only.
HN structures over Dedekind bases, stable/semistable moduli subfunctors, Definition 8.17, and the relative deformation theorem. Target only.
Theorem 9.1: finite pullback and faithfully-flat pushforward of stability conditions over a base. Target only.
Propositions 10.1--10.2, Theorem 10.3, and Corollary 10.5. Target only.
Skyscraper-sheaf stability, its moduli interpretation, and Bondal--Orlov reconstruction. Target only.
Inducing t-structures and slicings. SF7 delivered substantial candidate infrastructure, but this coordinate remains target pending direct source review.
Almost-disconnected morphisms, the filtration property, and the `(P¹)^n → P^n` quotient. Target only.

Candidate mapping only. The abstract strict/weak order, Lemma-3.13 characterizations, autoequivalence Bayer property, and categorical cofiltration shape are represented. The scheme-specific filtration/cofiltration hypotheses and Propositions 3.21 and 3.24--3.27 are not claimed. Mapped is not coverage.
